title: What each platform would do — not claimed customers.
desc: No fabricated case studies or customer names appear on this site. These are concept demonstrations of the intended workflow, clearly labeled as such.

items.title: UrbanOS — Municipal Permit Workflow
items.text: A concept walkthrough of how a housing-development permit could move from application to inspection to approval inside UrbanOS, with an AI-prioritized inspection queue.

items.title: Fiscra — Audit Trail Example
items.text: A sample maker/checker audit trail showing how a journal entry moves through review, flagging, and approval — illustrative data only, no real client figures.

items.title: Trovec REIT OS — Scheme Readiness Assessment
items.text: An illustrative walkthrough of the REIT readiness scoring model used with design-partner RMCs, showing how confidence and sourcing are attached to every figure.
